properties.text: Precompile must not revert under any input; only OOG causes revert.
properties.assertion: forall input: p256verify(input) != REVERT || gas < 6900

properties.text: Gas cost is exactly 6900 regardless of input validity or execution path.
properties.assertion: forall input, path: gas_consumed(p256verify(input)) == 6900

properties.text: Output is exactly 32 bytes (0x01 padded) on success or 0 bytes on failure.
properties.assertion: forall input: len(output) == 32 && output == 0x01_u256 || len(output) == 0

properties.text: Input must be exactly 160 bytes; shorter or longer inputs return empty.
properties.assertion: forall input: len(input) != 160 => p256verify(input) == empty

properties.text: Scalars r and s must satisfy 0 < value < n (subgroup order) for valid input.
properties.assertion: forall r, s: valid_input(r, s) => 0 < r < n && 0 < s < n

properties.text: Public key coordinates must satisfy 0 <= qx,qy < p (field modulus).
properties.assertion: forall qx, qy: valid_point(qx, qy) => 0 <= qx < p && 0 <= qy < p

properties.text: Public key point must lie on the secp256r1 curve: qy^2 == qx^3 + ax + b (mod p).
properties.assertion: forall qx, qy: valid_point(qx, qy) => qy^2 % p == (qx^3 + a*qx + b) % p

properties.text: Point at infinity (0,0) must be rejected during validation.
properties.assertion: forall qx, qy: (qx == 0 && qy == 0) => valid_point(qx, qy) == false

properties.text: Signature verify must check R' != infinity before x-coordinate comparison.
properties.assertion: forall h,r,s,Q: verify(h,r,s,Q) => R_prime != point_at_infinity checked before R'.x == r

properties.text: Final comparison must use modular reduction: R'.x mod n == r, not direct equality.
properties.assertion: forall h,r,s,Q: verify_cmp(R_prime, r) == (R_prime.x % n == r % n)

properties.text: Modular inverse must be computed mod subgroup order n, not field modulus p.
properties.assertion: forall s: s_inv(s) == modpow(s, n-2, n)

properties.text: Input fields decoded as 5 big-endian 32-byte unsigned integers from 160-byte input.
properties.assertion: forall input: decode(input) == (BE(input[0:32]), BE(input[32:64]), BE(input[64:96]), BE(input[96:128]), BE(input[128:160]))

properties.text: Validation checks must execute in spec order: length, r, s, qx, qy, curve, infinity.
properties.assertion: forall input: validate_order(input) == [len_check, r_check, s_check, qx_check, qy_check, curve_check, inf_check]

properties.text: Bounds checks for qx, qy must use field modulus p, not subgroup order n.
properties.assertion: forall qx, qy: bounds_check(qx, qy) uses p == 0xffffffff00000001000000000000000000000000ffffffffffffffffffffffff

properties.text: Scalar multiplications and point addition use secp256r1 curve parameters, not secp256k1.
properties.assertion: forall op in {ecmul, ecadd}: op.curve_params == SECP256R1_PARAMS

properties.text: All clients must produce identical output for identical precompile input (consensus).
properties.assertion: forall input, client_a, client_b: p256verify_a(input) == p256verify_b(input)

properties.text: Any optimized verification path must accept/reject same inputs as spec algorithm.
properties.assertion: forall input: optimized_verify(input) == spec_verify(input)

properties.text: Cached or precomputed curve tables must produce same results as direct computation.
properties.assertion: forall P, k: cached_ecmul(k, P) == direct_ecmul(k, P)

properties.text: Valid signature with valid key returns 32-byte 0x01; invalid returns empty bytes.
properties.assertion: forall h,r,s,Q: ECDSA_valid(h,r,s,Q) => output == bytes32(1) && !ECDSA_valid => output == bytes(0)

properties.text: Precompile at address 0x100 must be recognized and routed correctly in all clients.
properties.assertion: forall client: precompile_registry(0x100) == p256verify

properties.text: Blob commitment count must not exceed get_blob_parameters limit for current epoch.
properties.assertion: forall block, epoch: len(block.blob_kzg_commitments) <= get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block

properties.text: Execution payload parent_hash must chain to latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash.
properties.assertion: forall payload: payload.parent_hash == state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash

properties.text: Execution payload timestamp must equal computed time at slot.
properties.assertion: forall payload, state: payload.timestamp == compute_time_at_slot(state, state.slot)

properties.text: Execution payload prev_randao must match current epoch randao mix.
properties.assertion: forall payload, state: payload.prev_randao == get_randao_mix(state, get_current_epoch(state))

properties.text: BLOB_SCHEDULE entries must have unique epoch values.
properties.assertion: forall i, j: i != j => BLOB_SCHEDULE[i].epoch != BLOB_SCHEDULE[j].epoch

properties.text: All BLOB_SCHEDULE max_blobs_per_block values must not exceed MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK.
properties.assertion: forall entry in BLOB_SCHEDULE: entry.max_blobs_per_block <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK

properties.text: get_blob_parameters defaults to ELECTRA parameters when no schedule entry matches.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: no_match(epoch, BLOB_SCHEDULE) => get_blob_parameters(epoch) == BlobParameters(ELECTRA)

properties.text: Fork digest must incorporate blob parameters via XOR for network segmentation.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: fork_digest(epoch) == truncate4(fork_data_root XOR hash(blob_params(epoch)))

properties.text: Different blob configurations at same fork must produce different fork digests.
properties.assertion: forall e, bp1, bp2: bp1 != bp2 => fork_digest(e, bp1) != fork_digest(e, bp2)

properties.text: compute_proposer_indices must return exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH indices.
properties.assertion: forall state, epoch: len(compute_proposer_indices(state, epoch)) == SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

properties.text: All proposer indices must be from the active validator set for the given epoch.
properties.assertion: forall idx in compute_proposer_indices(state, epoch): idx in get_active_validator_indices(state, epoch)

properties.text: get_beacon_proposer_index must use pre-calculated lookahead, not recompute on-demand.
properties.assertion: forall state: get_beacon_proposer_index(state) == state.proposer_lookahead[state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]

properties.text: Proposer lookahead and on-demand computation must agree for current epoch slots.
properties.assertion: forall state, slot: lookahead[slot % SPE] == compute_proposer_index(state, slot_to_seed(slot))

properties.text: Only active validators for the target epoch are eligible for proposer selection.
properties.assertion: forall state, epoch: proposer_candidates(epoch) == get_active_validator_indices(state, epoch)

properties.text: Proposer seed must be domain-separated using DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER.
properties.assertion: forall state, epoch: proposer_seed(state, epoch) == get_seed(state, epoch, DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER)

properties.text: All 15 epoch sub-processes must execute in strict sequential order.
properties.assertion: forall state: process_epoch(state) executes [just, inact, rewards, ..., lookahead] sequentially

properties.text: process_proposer_lookahead must be the final step in process_epoch.
properties.assertion: forall state: epoch_steps(state)[-1] == process_proposer_lookahead

properties.text: Lookahead shift removes exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries from the front.
properties.assertion: forall state: post_shift_len == pre_shift_len - SLOTS_PER_EPOCH + SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

properties.text: New lookahead proposers are computed for epoch N+MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1 at epoch N.
properties.assertion: forall epoch N: new_proposers_epoch == N + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1

properties.text: proposer_lookahead length remains (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH after update.
properties.assertion: forall state: len(state.proposer_lookahead) == (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; unauthenticated callers cannot invoke newPayload.
properties.assertion: forall caller: engine_api.newPayload(caller) => caller.jwt_valid == true

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all incoming blocks/attestations must be fully validated.
properties.assertion: forall msg from P2P: process(msg) requires full_validation(msg) == true

properties.text: Proposer lookahead for epoch N+1 must be available at start of epoch N.
properties.assertion: forall epoch N, slot in N+1: state.proposer_lookahead contains proposer for slot

properties.text: Proposer selection seed per slot is uniquely derived from base seed and slot offset.
properties.assertion: forall i, j: i != j => hash(seed + uint_to_bytes(start_slot + i)) != hash(seed + uint_to_bytes(start_slot + j))

properties.text: Execution engine must validate and accept payload before header is cached in state.
properties.assertion: forall payload: state.update_header(payload) requires execution_engine.verify(payload) == true

properties.text: Fork digest result must be truncated to exactly 4 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: len(compute_fork_digest(epoch)) == 4

properties.text: State mutations from earlier epoch sub-processes must be visible to later sub-processes.
properties.assertion: forall step_i, step_j: i < j => step_j sees mutations from step_i

properties.text: Blob parameter hash uses both epoch and max_blobs_per_block encoded as uint_to_bytes.
properties.assertion: forall bp: blob_hash(bp) == hash(uint_to_bytes(bp.epoch) + uint_to_bytes(bp.max_blobs_per_block))

properties.text: All BLOB_SCHEDULE epoch values must be >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
properties.assertion: forall entry in BLOB_SCHEDULE: entry.EPOCH >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH
